text:
marta: Quick preflight checklist for Thurs live demo (10am PT). Need: registration copy QA, two reminder cadences, captioning plan (live + post-edit), recording redundancy, clip tagging, and HubSpot routing. Assigning owners now.

lee: I can take registration copy and reminder content. Will add an accessibility blurb and a short alt-text for hero image. Also propose adding a short question on the reg form: "Which use-case best describes you?" (choices).

oscar: Video ops: I'll own recording redundancy. Plan: cloud recording + local OBS backup RTMP -> backup.redwood.com/live. Also enable "record separate audio files" and stage manual fallback if cloud fails.

ria: I'll own captions. Live: enable Zoom auto-captions for speed, but we'll run post-event human QA and generate EN SRT + one translated SRT (FR). Where to store? Suggest s3://redwood-marketing/accessibility/2026-launch/.

chun: HubSpot rules: utm_source=webinar, utm_campaign=launch-spring. Routing: company_size>1000 -> AE; else nurture. Capture custom prop "primary_use_case" from reg form. Also set contact prop 'requested_accessible_format' if attendee checks accessibility needs.

ops-bot: deploy: rtmp_backup_rule created -> target: rtmp://backup.redwood.com/live, retention: 14d

lee: Reminder cadence: 48h, 2h, 10m local time. For registrants who request captions, send a reminder with a link to request a live ASL interpreter (if they opt-in). We'll add pref_contact_time field to help schedule live captioner.

marta: Clip priority: 1) 90s demo highlight, 2) 45s benchmark stat, 3) 30s CTA. Tag each clip in sheet with "use_case" + "language". Editors: first pass by Ria for caption sync; final polish by contractor if needed.

oscar: Greenroom checklist: test audio @9:15 PT, confirm slides as PDF in Zoom chat, verify panelist display names, test OBS fallback. I'll be in greenroom 9-9:45.

ria: Transcription pipeline: pull Zoom VTT -> run QA -> generate per-speaker SRT + merged captions.vtt. Translation pipeline to produce fr.srt within 24h. I'll put deliverables list in the sheet.

chun: Webhook mapping: replay_clicked -> Segment track 'replay_clicked' with {utm_campaign, primary_use_case, language}. Map to HubSpot timeline and set watched_replay true. Anyone want to own payload example?

lee: I will draft the email copy and include UTM templates. Will add two subject line variants and A/B plan in the sheet.

marta: Post-event cadence: 1) immediate replay + caption download links, 2) 48h clips email segmented by use_case, 3) 7d deeper dive + offer a pilot demo. Owners: marta (coord), lee (emails), oscar (video deliverables), ria (captions).

oscar: upload: recording 3331234700 uploaded -> s3://redwood-marketing/accessibility/2026-launch/recordings/3331234700.mp4

ops-bot: transcribe: job tx-3331234720 started -> outputs: raw_vtt, speaker_segments

ria: Note: flag low-confidence segments (<0.85) for manual correction. Also produce a redacted transcript variant (remove attendee names) for public FAQ.

marta: Final asks: update the post-event triage sheet within 6 hours with clip owners, caption links, and HubSpot tags. I'll audit at 5pm PT. If anything blocks, ping #marketing-ops and @marta. :white_check_mark:
